extensionDescription.message: Spots fake online shops: brand impersonation, newly registered domains, suspicious legal notices.

popupActivateLede.message: GuardFou needs access to the pages you visit to analyze them.

popupEmpty.message: No analysis for this page: it wasn't detected as a shop, or it has only just loaded.

popupIdentityNeedsReload.message: Reload the page to see its identity card.

popupIdentityUnavailable.message: No identity card for this page.

cardNoLegalLinks.message: No legal notice or terms of sale link found on the page.

cardLanguageMismatch.message: Not in the language the site declares: possibly a poor translation.

cardLegalTooShort.message: Very short text, possibly a generic template.

cardLegalNothingToReport.message: Nothing in particular to report (a quick automatic check, not a proofread).

cardMandatoryUnchecked.message: Can't be checked (no legal notice page found).

cardNoCompanyNumber.message: No SIRET/SIREN number found on the page.

cardCompanyNumberInvalid.message: Invalid format (checksum failed): probably mistyped or made up.

cardCompanyNotFound.message: Not in the official French company registry.

cardNotAvailableYet.message: Not available (needs a paid source or an API key); planned for a later version.

seoTitleLength.message: Page title of reasonable length ($1 characters)

seoImageAlt.message: Alt text on most images ($1/$2 without an alt attribute)

reasonIpHostname.message: The site is reached through a raw IP address instead of a domain name, which is extremely rare for a legitimate site.

reasonUserinfoAtSymbol.message: The address contains an “@” before the domain name, a trick used to disguise a fake address as a real one.

reasonFakeHttpsToken.message: The word “https” appears in the domain name itself, a trick to look safer than it is.

reasonRedirectionInPath.message: The address contains “//” in its path, which can hide a redirect to another site.

reasonInsecureHttp.message: The site doesn't use HTTPS: the connection isn't encrypted.

reasonSharedHosting.message: Site hosted on a subdomain of $1: it has no domain name of its own, so its age can't be checked.

reasonDomainVeryNew.message: The domain name was registered only $1 days ago.

reasonDomainNew.message: The domain name is less than a year old ($1 months).

reasonDomainOld.message: The domain name has existed for more than 5 years.

reasonShortRegistrationSpan.message: The domain was registered for about a year only, the minimum, rather than several years ahead.

reasonWatchedRegistrar.message: Recent domain registered through $1, a registrar already seen on short-lived shops.

reasonDnssecBogus.message: The domain's DNSSEC validation fails (invalid signature): a possible sign of DNS hijacking or spoofing.

reasonDnssecOk.message: The domain is protected by DNSSEC and its signature is valid.

reasonLegalPageMissing.message: No legal notice page found on the site, although every site in France must have one.

reasonIncompleteLegalMentionsOne.message: Incomplete legal notice: 1 required item missing ($1).

reasonIncompleteLegalMentionsOther.message: Incomplete legal notice: $1 required items missing ($2).

reasonSiretInvalidChecksum.message: The SIRET/SIREN number in the legal notice is malformed (checksum failed).

reasonSiretNotFound.message: The SIRET/SIREN number shown doesn't exist in the official French company registry.

reasonCompanyClosed.message: The company behind the SIRET (“$1”) is listed as closed in the official registry.

reasonCompanyNameMismatch.message: The SIRET is valid and active, but belongs to “$1”, a different name from the one on the site: possibly a real SIRET reused.

reasonBrandDomainMismatch.message: The site presents itself as “$1” but its domain isn't $2.

reasonBrandLookalikeDomain.message: The domain name looks like that of “$1” ($2), with an added word or a close spelling.

optionsAccessButton.message: Allow access to the pages you visit

optionsAccessMissing.message: Access not granted: GuardFou can't analyze any page.

optionsTrustedHint.message: These domains will never be flagged.

optionsRegistrarsHint.message: Flagged lightly (+8) only when the domain is also recent (under 2 years): the registrar alone proves nothing.

optionsRegistrarsAddHint.message: Add others you have seen yourself.

optionsAutoHint.message: By default, domain age is only checked automatically on pages that look like a shop or name a known brand; other sites are checked when you open their identity card. On every site, a domain under 6 months old is flagged orange even if it sells nothing, and every domain you visit is sent to rdap.org (at most once a week).

optionsCheckAgeEverywhere.message: Check domain age on every site

optionsLanguageHint.message: Language of the popup, this page and the warning banner. Pages already checked switch on their next load.

optionsCacheHint.message: Domain, DNSSEC and legal-notice results are kept for 7 days to limit network requests. Clear the cache if you think a result is out of date or a lookup failed temporarily.

optionsDisableCache.message: Turn off the cache (re-checks everything every time: useful for testing, but more network requests)
